No worries at all, Alex — thanks for the heads-up and glad everything is OK. Two quick paths to get back on track — pick whichever is easiest: 

1) Same-week live options (I blocked a few windows):
- Tue Mar 10 · 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Tue Mar 10 · 3:00–3:30 PM PST
- Wed Mar 11 · 9:30–10:00 AM PST

2) Self-serve: pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/intro-30 (I keep it up-to-date with availability)

3) Async option: if it's easier while you're handling incidents, I can send a short 7–10 minute recorded walkthrough tailored to your stack (onboarding flow, sample latency/cost numbers for comparable customers) plus a one-paragraph recommended next step — you can watch whenever.

If you pick option 1, reply with the time that works and we'll lock it. If option 2, use the Calendly link. If option 3, say "async" and I'll send the recording plus a brief agenda. Also, any high-level constraints (cloud provider, preferred inference latency target, compliance needs) would help me tailor the walkthrough.

[Attachment: meeting-template-10m.pdf (one-pager agenda)]

Thanks — I can be flexible on Tuesday afternoon if mornings are tough. Marissa, looping you in so we have AE coverage.

—
Ben
